name: MiniGit
shortDescription: Lightweight Git hosting with per-repo Pearl isolation and wallet-rooted clone credentials.
description:
MiniGit provides lightweight, private Git hosting inside a Melusina Pearl. Clone, push, browse commits, diffs, and manage branches — all from your browser, entirely on your server.

## Why MiniGit

- **Per-repo Pearl isolation** — each repository is a sealed container; separate storage, separate permissions; no cross-repo leakage; a vulnerability in one repo cannot reach another
- **Wallet-rooted clone credentials** — clone credentials tied to your Solana wallet; non-repudiable access logs; revoke access anytime via Grapple
- **No third-party CDN/Git gateway** — all repositories hosted locally; no GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket; no vendor lock-in; export anytime

## Features

- **Create a repository Pearl in one click**
- **Push and pull over HTTPS** — clone URL provided automatically
- **Browse files, commits, and diffs** — in the web UI
- **Share read-only or read/write access** — via standard Melusina sharing
- **SQLite-backed** — zero external dependencies
- **Fully offline-capable** — no CDN or external calls
- **Role-based access** — viewer, commenter, editor, admin

## Suite integration

MiniGit talks Grapple to the rest of Melusina — trigger Bureau Doc builds on commit, surface release notes in a CanBoard card, attach code diffs to a review Pearl.

## Status

*Pre-release.* The pearl currently installs as a Coming Soon stub; the live Git interface lands in v0.2.
